invariants: one dataset identity has one canonical definition
one logical dataset cannot have multiple declared sources of truth
projection and index datasets cannot be declared source of truth
write authority requires canonical owner and write port match
projection cursor accepts only the next ordered event
duplicate applied event is skipped without reapplication
migration requires before evidence, after validation and rollback point
restore requires owner, dataset, schema and integrity hash match
physical backup transport and database migration execution remain adapter responsibilities
